purpose: Let multiple identical fresh worker chats self-select distinct high-value safe work now, while the full autonomous swarm kernel is still under construction.
claim_protocol: For each READY opportunity in priority order, attempt GitHub create-file on coordination/opportunities/claims/<opportunity_id>.json. Create-if-absent is the exclusive pin. If creation conflicts because the file exists, reload queue/claims and try the next READY item. Never overwrite another claim.
run_protocol: After a successful claim, create a new run artifact at coordination/opportunities/runs/<opportunity_id>/<run_id>.json with state STARTED before substantive work; then execute only the declared mission/read_scope/write_scope; persist RETURN at coordination/opportunities/returns/<opportunity_id>/<run_id>.json; then update only your own run to DONE. No shared authority promotion.
post_return: After DONE, reload this queue. If another unclaimed READY opportunity is compatible and your context remains useful, you may claim exactly one more; otherwise stop with IDLE_NO_SAFE_WORK in your run.

Read the original WI-BIG-09 JOB, the 16/18 convergence checkpoint, Architecture/Active Method drafts, Survival Set and current authority rules. Produce evidence-backed integration state machine, conflict reconciliation, consumption ledger, owner/steward rules, promotion/rollback evidence and falsifying tests. Do not mutate shared architecture or authority heads.
opportunities.write_scope: claim + own run + own return only
opportunities.return_contract: Structured evidence-backed candidate sufficient for parent to close the WI-BIG-09 coverage gate.
